theorem: For a rooted all-odd refinement DAG in which every vertex is reachable, path-independent F2 twists are exactly vertex coboundaries b_uv=phi_u+phi_v, so the coherent space has dimension |V|-1. A coarse-graining retaining a subset of vertices pushes a coherent twist forward by restricting phi; it is surjective, and its kernel has dimension equal to the number of eliminated nonroot vertices. For mixed parity, equality of affine linear parts on every contracted path is an additional necessary obstruction.
